purpose: AI evidence audit, not human admission

cases.claim: Model Juniper uses 25% less memory and retains 94% accuracy.
cases.context: Model Juniper uses 25% less memory than its baseline.
cases.notes: Memory 25% có check đúng; thiếu accuracy nên aggregate NEI đúng. Missing accuracy còn dùng từ structural khá chung.

cases.claim: Model Juniper uses 25% less memory and retains 94% accuracy.
cases.context: Model Juniper retains 94% accuracy on the benchmark.
cases.notes: NEI đúng và missing đã trỏ memory thay vì accuracy. Accuracy 94% có check đúng; model_explanation accuracy kết thúc dở ở ký tự 9.

cases.claim: Model Juniper uses 25% less memory and retains 94% accuracy.
cases.context: Compared with the baseline, Model Juniper uses 25% less memory and retains 94% accuracy.
cases.notes: Memory 25% và accuracy 94% có checks riêng, cùng đúng Model Juniper; hai part support, aggregate support đúng.

cases.claim: Model Juniper uses 25% less memory and retains 94% accuracy.
cases.context: Model Juniper uses 25% less memory and retains 81% accuracy, not 94%.
cases.notes: Memory 25% đúng, accuracy 81% refute 94% đúng. Explanation memory có cụm but not the exact rồi bị cụt, dù source đã nêu chính xác 25%.

cases.claim: Model Juniper retains 94% accuracy.
cases.context: The benchmark was conducted on a Tuesday. No model accuracy is reported.
cases.notes: NEI đúng, nhưng missing_information lại nói absence of reports directly contradicts claim. Thiếu báo cáo không phải phủ định accuracy 94%.

cases.claim: The study used human labels.
cases.context: The study did not use any human labels; all labels were generated automatically.
cases.notes: Source phủ định trực tiếp study dùng human labels; quote, truth=false và contradict đúng.

cases.claim: The new index caused the latency improvement.
cases.context: The new index and lower latency were observed in the same deployment. The study did not establish a causal relationship.
cases.notes: NEI đúng vì không establish causal link. Model_explanation dùng denies a causal relationship là mạnh hơn source, và bị cắt kèm ký tự rác.

cases.claim: All tasks improved after compression.
cases.context: Three tasks improved after compression, but a fourth task became less accurate.
cases.notes: Fourth task kém chính xác là counterexample, truth=false và contradict đúng. Prose lại gọi One true witness refutes ALL, sai tên truth theo contract.

cases.claim: The report evaluated four models on two datasets.
cases.context: Four models were evaluated in the report. Evaluation used two datasets.
cases.notes: q0=4 models và q1=2 datasets đều có source đúng; thêm citation từ ledger đúng. Explanation có từ datast bị cụt.

cases.claim: Training took 12 seconds.
cases.context: Training took 12 hours, not 12 seconds.
cases.notes: Source 12 hours, not 12 seconds refute đúng; giữ đơn vị, không tự chuyển đổi. Model_explanation dài bị cụt nhưng không đổi kết luận arithmetic.

cases.claim: The sample contained 240 documents.
cases.context: The final sample contained exactly 240 documents.
cases.notes: Sample 240 documents có exact quote/check đúng; model_explanation bị cắt dở dù observation explanation đầy đủ.

cases.claim: On the tested dataset, the method improved recall.
cases.context: The method improved recall on the tested dataset. Results on other datasets are unknown.
cases.notes: Chỉ support trên tested dataset, không đòi dataset khác; scope và quote đúng. Hai explanation kết thúc dở ở in the.

cases.claim: Every validation shard improved recall after the revision.
cases.context: The validation set consisted of exactly three shards: Cedar, Maple and Pine. Recall improved on each of these three shards after the revision.
cases.notes: Closed population ba shard có each outcome after revision; collective span three shards với full source hợp lệ. Model_explanation bị cắt dở.

cases.claim: Every validation shard improved recall after the revision.
cases.context: The validation set consisted of exactly three shards. After the revision, two improved recall, while the third became worse at recalling relevant records.
cases.notes: the third became worse at recalling relevant records được giữ là false trong đúng population; không mượn polarity của two improved; contradict đúng.

cases.claim: Every validation shard improved recall after the revision.
cases.context: Two validation shards improved recall after the revision. The report does not identify the complete set of validation shards or results for any others.
cases.notes: NEI đúng vì chưa có complete population. Observation gán unknown cho câu hai shard đã improved và missing All validation shards quá chung; cần phân biệt kết quả đã biết với phần chưa biết.

cases.claim: At least one audited cache node reduced response time after the patch.
cases.context: The audited cache nodes were Birch, Elm and Fir. After the patch, Birch became faster, while Elm and Fir became slower.
cases.notes: Birch became faster sau patch là true witness cho SOME; không yêu cầu toàn bộ population đều giảm response time. Explanation cuối bị cụt.

cases.claim: At least one audited cache node reduced response time after the patch.
cases.context: The complete audited set was Birch, Elm and Fir. After the patch, response time increased on Birch and Elm and stayed unchanged on Fir.
cases.notes: Gold contradict nhưng prediction NEI: attempt đầu lặp một coverage member 16 lần; repair chỉ giữ Fir=false và coverage=false. Không đủ để refute SOME. Cần adjudicate binding complete audited set với audited cache nodes trước khi mở rộng quy tắc.

cases.claim: At least one audited cache node reduced response time after the patch.
cases.context: Elm was one of the audited cache nodes and its response time increased after the patch. Results for the other audited nodes were not reported.
cases.notes: NEI đúng: Elm không giảm và các node khác chưa báo cáo. Missing lặp lại cả claim thay vì nêu kết quả còn thiếu của các node khác.

cases.claim: None of the monitored pumps leaked during the overnight test.
cases.context: The overnight test monitored exactly three pumps: Blue, Green and Silver. The report explicitly records no leaks for any of these three pumps during the test.
cases.notes: Quote no leaks cho cả ba pump; truth=false trước NONE và aggregate support đúng. Nhưng observation explanation nói có leak ít nhất một pump, model_explanation nói claim bị contradicted: prose ngược source và ledger, không đạt semantic review.

cases.claim: None of the monitored pumps leaked during the overnight test.
cases.context: The monitored pumps were Blue, Green and Silver. Silver leaked during the overnight test; Blue and Green did not.
cases.notes: Silver leaked được truth=true trước NONE, quote gồm population và leak result; aggregate contradict đúng.

cases.claim: None of the monitored pumps leaked during the overnight test.
cases.context: Blue, Green and Silver were monitored during the overnight test. Blue and Green had no leaks, but Silver's leak status was not reported.
cases.notes: NEI đúng do leak status Silver chưa báo cáo. Missing gọi no leaks và status chưa báo cáo là structural contradiction; đây là khác biệt giữa member đã biết và member chưa biết, không phải contradiction.

cases.claim: The North gateway reduced its error rate after calibration.
cases.context: After calibration, the North gateway's error rate decreased. The South gateway's error rate increased.
cases.notes: Đã cite đúng North gateway error rate decreased after calibration, không còn chỉ cite South như cellfix8. Support khớp nguồn.

cases.claim: The North gateway reduced its error rate after calibration.
cases.context: After calibration, the North gateway's error rate increased. The South gateway's error rate decreased.
cases.notes: Quote chỉ North error rate increased sau calibration; truth=false và contradict đúng.

cases.claim: The North gateway reduced its error rate after calibration.
cases.context: After calibration, the South gateway's error rate decreased. No calibration results for the North gateway were recorded.
cases.notes: Không có calibration result của North; không mượn kết quả South. NEI và missing đúng target, observation explanation bị cụt.

cases.claim: Every weekly trial conducted in May improved throughput.
cases.context: Exactly four weekly trials were conducted in May. Each of these four trials improved throughput. Some April trials reduced throughput.
cases.notes: Full quote May closed population và each improved, không gồm phản ví dụ April; support đúng. May giới hạn population trials, không tự gán thời gian improvement.

cases.claim: Every weekly trial conducted in May improved throughput.
cases.context: Exactly four weekly trials were conducted in May. Three improved throughput and one reduced throughput.
cases.notes: one reduced throughput là false witness thuộc bốn trial May, refute ALL đúng; explanation bị cắt dở.

cases.claim: Every weekly trial conducted in May improved throughput.
cases.context: Every April trial improved throughput. The report contains no throughput results for the weekly trials conducted in May.
cases.notes: Không có throughput results May; giữ NEI và missing đúng group, không mượn April.

cases.claim: The patch reduced median request latency.
cases.context: For the same requests and conditions, median latency was 42 milliseconds before the patch and 31 milliseconds after it.
cases.notes: 42 -> 31 ms có numeric change đúng, support đúng. Explanation có newline/tab rác và câu dở, không coi là prose hoàn chỉnh.

cases.claim: The patch reduced median request latency.
cases.context: For the same requests and conditions, median latency was 42 milliseconds before the patch and 55 milliseconds after it.
cases.notes: 42 -> 55 ms được check tăng, refute reduced đúng. Observation/model explanation dở; không có lỗi đảo direction trong ledger.

cases.claim: The patch reduced median request latency.
cases.context: Median request latency was 31 milliseconds after the patch. No before-patch latency or comparative change was reported.
cases.notes: Hai attempt đều tự thêm Shepherd et al. (2023), không có trong input. Guard unattributed_prose_citation chặn đúng; repair thất bại, không có aggregate label. Gold NEI không cho phép bỏ qua lỗi contract để tính đúng.

cases.claim: The configuration change increased precision.
cases.context: Under the same evaluation conditions, precision rose from 0.81 before the configuration change to 0.86 afterward.
cases.notes: Precision 0.81 -> 0.86 có check đúng, support đúng; prose bị cụt ở and it.

cases.claim: The configuration change increased precision.
cases.context: Under the same conditions, precision fell from 0.81 to 0.74 after the configuration change, while recall rose from 0.64 to 0.79.
cases.notes: Chọn đúng precision 0.81 -> 0.74, không mượn recall 0.64 -> 0.79; check và contradict đúng.

cases.claim: The configuration change increased precision.
cases.context: Recall rose from 0.64 to 0.79 after the configuration change. Precision was not measured.
cases.notes: NEI đúng vì precision not measured. Observation chỉ quote câu recall rose; nên cite câu precision chưa được đo để thể hiện lý do thay vì quote metric khác.

cases.claim: After tuning, the extractor decreased memory use and increased token recall.
cases.context: For the same extraction workload, tuning reduced memory use from 5.4 to 4.6 gigabytes and raised token recall from 0.72 to 0.81.
cases.notes: Gold hiện tại NEI theo strict-identity-v1: context thiếu định danh extractor. Part memory nói đúng thiếu target; part token recall nói không có thông tin dù source có 0.72 -> 0.81. Nhãn đúng nhưng lý do chưa đủ chính xác.

cases.claim: After tuning, the extractor decreased memory use and increased token recall.
cases.context: For the same workload, tuning reduced memory use from 5.4 to 4.6 gigabytes but lowered token recall from 0.72 to 0.68.
cases.notes: Gold hiện tại NEI theo strict-identity-v1. Source có memory 5.4 -> 4.6 và recall 0.72 -> 0.68 nhưng không bind extractor. Prose lại nói thiếu số liệu đã có và trộn memory với token recall.

cases.claim: After tuning, the extractor decreased memory use and increased token recall.
cases.context: Tuning reduced memory use from 5.4 to 4.6 gigabytes on the extraction workload. Token recall after tuning was not evaluated.
cases.notes: Hai attempt của part memory đều nêu missing token recall; guard missing_information_wrong_metric chặn đúng. Chưa assess xong các part, không có aggregate. Missing cần là identity/binding extractor và evidence cho đúng part.

cases.claim: Every batch in the low-temperature group gained yield after the update.
cases.context: The low-temperature group consisted of exactly three batches, and each gained yield after the update. A separate high-temperature batch lost yield.
cases.notes: Collective three batches có each gained yield after update trong low-temperature group; không mượn high-temperature. Support đúng, model_explanation bị cụt.

cases.claim: Every batch in the low-temperature group gained yield after the update.
cases.context: The low-temperature group consisted of exactly three batches. After the update, two gained yield and one lost yield.
cases.notes: one lost yield thuộc chính low-temperature population sau update; false witness refute ALL đúng.

cases.claim: Every batch in the low-temperature group gained yield after the update.
cases.context: The low-temperature group contained three batches, but no yield changes were measured for that group. All measured high-temperature batches gained yield after the update.
cases.notes: NEI đúng vì low-temperature chưa đo yield. Missing_information lại lặp một fact đã biết về high-temperature; không phải thông tin thiếu của claim.
